name: Tiempo
overview: Scripture reveals that time is sovereignly governed by the LORD, who directs our steps and holds our days in His hand, as seen in Psalms 31:15 and Proverbs 16:9. Believers are called to recognize the brevity and uncertainty of life, wisely numbering their days to gain understanding (Psalms 90:12) and refraining from boasting about the future (Proverbs 27:1). Ecclesiastes 3:1 reminds us that every event and purpose has its appointed season under heaven, encouraging trust in God's perfect timing.
